context: Two teens debrief a school event
purpose: Teach: 思いつき/はなれ/溢れる/心情/各々/持ち込ん/見受け/ノン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、各々の出し物がすごく溢れる元気で、見受けた感想は最高だった。
lines.en: The cultural festival was amazing — every single booth was bursting with energy.
lines.style: Bright, animated opening. Quick pace, genuine enthusiasm. Leans forward slightly. Eyes widening on 'amazing.' Natural, unguarded teen voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 私の心情、サクラの劇に思いつきで参加した瞬間、感動だった。
lines.en: When I suddenly decided to jump into your play, I was genuinely moved.
lines.style: Softer shift. Slight hesitation before admitting the emotion — not used to being this sincere out loud. Quieter, more careful with the words. Eyes meeting hers briefly then away.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 急に持ち込ん来た小道具、ハマってたよね。
lines.en: The prop you threw together at the last second totally worked.
lines.style: Quick, pleased. Light teasing affection underneath. Rapid delivery, like she's shaking her head at him fondly. Slight laugh in the tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 席をはなれる時、皆で記念写真撮ったよな。
lines.en: Remember when we all took that group photo before we left?
lines.style: Nostalgic warmth. Slightly slower pace — savoring the memory. Soft tone, like he's inviting her to relive it with him. Genuine smile audible.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 打ち上げはノンアル飲み放題で、めっちゃ盛り上がった。
lines.en: The afterparty was non-alcoholic open bar, and everyone was so hyped.
lines.style: High energy finale. Bright, quick delivery. Small laugh baked in. Genuine happiness with no performance. Ends on an upswing, like the moment hasn't faded yet.
